video_title: Darko Rajakovic | Post Game vs  Boston Celtics | November 11, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic praises Grayson Allen's performance and energy
quotes.excerpt: I thought that Grayson Allen played a great game tonight with rebounding, with shooting the ball, with energy, with effort.
quotes.quote: I think a lot of young guys are getting opportunities to play out there. I think those minutes are super important for them. They are feeling valued on a team. I thought that Grayson Allen played a great game tonight with rebounding, with shooting the ball, with energy, with effort. I thought that the whole team did a really, really good job defensively against them. They scored 98 points, the team that's top five offensive ranking to start the season, and we did a really good job of containing the ball.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic praised Grayson Allen for his effort against Boston, noting his impact on the boards and defensive energy in a game where the Raptors held a top five offense to 98 points.

structured.context: Head coach Darko Rajakovic praises Grayson Allen for his performance and energy in the game against the Boston Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic discusses RJ Barrett's late-game rim attack
quotes.excerpt: We were looking to get RJ Barrett attacking. He got to the rim.
quotes.quote: We were looking to get RJ Barrett attacking. He got to the rim. I got to take a look at the film again. I'm not sure if he was fouled or not on that play, but nothing was called, so I guess there was no foul.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the late RJ Barrett drive that went uncalled: I am not sure if he was fouled or not on that play, but nothing was called, so I guess there was no foul.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's process for using challenges
quotes.excerpt: We have a process in place. We know what we want to challenge.
quotes.quote: We have a process in place. We know what we want to challenge. We want to challenge situations that we believe that we can save points, that we can get the possession back. Clippers game was a great example when we had both challenges at the end of the game. Use both of those, that helped us, and they turned out to be good challenges that went our way. Those are small, small possessions that can decide. Obviously, challenges are important, but also you don't want to come in a situation that you're down the stretch, you have a challenge that you did not save points earlier in the game. Points are points, doesn't matter if they happen in the first quarter or in the fourth quarter.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic explains his coaching philosophy on challenges: Points are points, it does not matter if they happen in the first quarter or in the fourth quarter.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the team's internal process and philosophy regarding when to use challenges during a game.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic evaluates Emmanuel Quickley's defensive return
quotes.excerpt: I thought defensively that he did a really good job. I thought that he was staying up with his man.
quotes.quote: I thought defensively that he did a really good job. I thought that he was staying up with his man pretty much whole night. This is his first game for him coming back from injury, and I think he was finding the way there for us. He did not make shots that he's usually making.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on Emmanuel Quickley returning from injury: I thought defensively that he did a really good job. He was staying up with his man pretty much the whole night.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic evaluates the defensive performance of Immanuel Quickley in his first game back from an injury.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic defines Elijah Fisher's role and defensive expectations
quotes.excerpt: Elijah Fisher's role is he needs to be pest defensively and he needs to knock down open shots.
quotes.quote: Elijah Fisher's role is he needs to be pest defensively and he needs to knock down open shots. For him being in this role tonight playing 16 minutes, he has to find that energy and the grit that he needs to come up with great defensive possessions and to knock down shots. And he did a good job tonight.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the role he has set for Elijah Fisher: He needs to be a pest defensively and he needs to knock down open shots.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic outlines the specific role and defensive expectations for Elijah Fisher.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic addresses the team's turnover issues
quotes.excerpt: A lot of them are live ball turnovers. If it's unforced and you just throw the ball in the hands of players, it's transition.
quotes.quote: A lot of them are live ball turnovers. If it's unforced and you just throw the ball in the hands of players, it's transition. So those are the really hard ones. As I said, first half, we had only three turnovers, which means that we had 12 in the second half, and that's just like execution and details and playing through fatigue. Even when you're tired, and right now we're a little bit short-handed with bodies, guys learning how to play through fatigue and still executing in those situations.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors turnover issues: We had 12 in the second half, and that is just execution and details and playing through fatigue.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic addresses the team's issues with turnovers and the need to execute better while playing through fatigue.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic explains why Grayson Allen is a good offensive rebounder
quotes.excerpt: He just goes after every rebound and he has a really good feel as well.
quotes.quote: He just goes after every rebound and he has a really good feel as well. We were in the Summer League and I told him like just focus on offensive, defensive rebounding and focus on playing defense, don't worry about the other stuff. We're going to be developing other stuff and that stuck with him and he's doing really, really good job with that.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on Grayson Allen's rebounding: I told him just focus on offensive, defensive rebounding and focus on playing defense, don't worry about the other stuff. That stuck with him.
